fields.System.Title: RPL-205 — Alert when no source exists
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want to be told when a pick face needs stock and there is none, so
that I find out now rather than when pickers start shorting.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a below-minimum location with no available source, then
  • replenishment.no_source_found is published and the location appears on the exception list.
  • - Given the exception, then it shows the location, product, quantity needed, and total
  • warehouse stock of that product.
  • - Given the same condition persisting, then the exception is not duplicated but its age
  • increases.
  • - Given stock becoming available later, then the exception clears automatically and a
  • task is created.
  • - Given the alert, then it reaches a person, not only a log line.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment, inventory |
| Tables | replen_run, outbox |
| Risks | Silent no-source condition, pick face runs dry mid-wave ([doc 09 §7.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
